_doc: RADE manifest (contract: rhope-ops/RADE schemas/rade-manifest.schema.json). Built by the RADE engine through scripts/build_paste_bundles.py (a pinned shim, see scripts/rade.lock.json). Each bundle is one round: a self-contained PowerShell text the PFM copies from its raw page and pastes into Windows PowerShell ISE (F5). It writes the files, then opens RADE, the Redacted Application Deployment Engine (a window; text prompts if no window can open): steps run one by one with a live log and PASS/FAIL counts, then one results folder (Rounds\\<round>: a report file plus copies of the PDFs, to attach to one e-mail; zips do not cross the boundary) and a summary for the clipboard. It runs only the steps inside it (PFM 3A). A step's "default" may be {passed, paths}: the step is ticked only when those files changed since the round that passed it; after a round passes it, set passed to the new hash (PFM 14 Nov 26). Never hand-edit scripts/gov/paste/*.ps1: change this file or the sources and rebuild. A step may list "needs" (check ids in the engine's $checkDefs) and "estimate" (minutes, used until a real run time exists). "apps" is the embedded catalog the Choose screen lists (name, plain-English summary, step names); without it, one application has every step. A guide step may set "doneText" (its Done button) and "doneLog" (the log line on Done).

bundles.title: Round R43 r1: my window r16 with grids beside the scroll bar, an endorser answer, a small CAC sign-in window, and RADE Back up and Restore of fake rows

steps.name: T22 Record the test install r16
steps.title: Record the test install of 90-161.Z 0.1
steps.note: The last step of the test install. RADE keeps an install record and saves its newest copy for the RADE shortcut. Nothing on the site changes.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
steps.doing: Recording the test install.

steps.name: T21 Check the test site is clean r12
steps.title: Check that the last round left nothing on the test site
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Removes a test list, library or Visitors member left by the last round.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. Each removal runs even when an earlier one fails.
steps.doing: Checking that the test site is clean.

steps.name: T21 Make the probe list r12
steps.title: Make the test list and library
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes the fake test list and library that the next step needs, with one fake workbook. The last step removes them again.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run changes nothing.
steps.doing: Making the test list and library.

steps.name: T21 Add the second person r12
steps.title: Add the second person to the test site
steps.note: A small window asks for the e-mail address of the second person. It stays on this computer. Adds that person to the site's Visitors group.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The address is never written to a file; the results show only yes or no.
after: T21 Make the probe list r12
steps.doing: Adding the second person to the Visitors group.

steps.name: T26 Make the fake publication r2
steps.title: Make the fake publication and endorsement
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes one fake publication (with OPR, level, type, 673 link) and one fake endorsement, or finds them. Puts 2 form links and 8 steps for the second person on the clipboard.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run makes no second row.
after: T21 Add the second person r12
steps.doing: Making the fake publication.

steps.name: T26 Second person answers r2
steps.title: Ask the second person to answer the endorsement
steps.note: You need one person of your office for about 5 minutes, now. They add one answer in the new row form, then try to change your fake endorsement in its edit form. A refusal there is expected.
guide: 1. Ask the second person to stay at a computer for 5 minutes.
2. Open Teams. You see the Teams window.
3. In Teams, click "Chat". You see your chats.
4. Click "New chat". You see the box "To".
5. In the box "To", type the e-mail address of the second person that you wrote down.
6. Click in the chat box at the bottom. You see the cursor in the box.
7. Press Ctrl+V. You see the 2 form links and 8 steps that RADE put on the clipboard.
8. Press Enter. You see your message in the chat.
9. Wait until the second person sends 2 replies. Do not click "Done" until then.
If nobody can help today: click "Skip". The round goes on and removes the test rows at the end.
after: T26 Make the fake publication r2

answers.prompt: After the new row form, what did the second person see?
After the edit form of your endorsement, what did the second person see?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: the second person tried the answer.

steps.name: T26 Read the endorser answer r2
steps.title: Read the 2 answers of the second person
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Reads the new answer row, and whether your fake endorsement was changed. A refused change is expected and recorded; it does not count against the round.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
steps.doing: Reading the answer of the second person.

steps.name: T22 Open the 90-161.Z window r16
steps.title: Open the 90-161.Z window and walk every screen
steps.note: Signs in (CAC) and reads the fake rows of your test site; writes nothing. In the window "Publications and Forms Management", do the 22 lines of its bottom bar. Then close it with its X.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
steps.doing: Opening the 90-161.Z window.

steps.name: T22 Did the window open r16
steps.title: Check that the window opened
steps.note: Reads the result of the window step and opens nothing. Passes when the window opened, so the look questions run even when a check failed.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
steps.doing: Reading the result of the window step.

steps.name: T22 Answer: look and cards r16
steps.title: Answer 2 questions about the window
steps.note: 2 questions: the answer of the second person and your first change. About 2 minutes.
after: T22 Did the window open r16

answers.prompt: At screen 11 of 18, did the grid "Wave 1 answers" show the second person?
What would you change first? One line, no names.

steps.name: T26 Make the Restore test rows r2
steps.title: Make the fake rows for the Restore test
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Sets the pause-switch row of PFM Settings to No (Restore turns it on while it writes; flows read it from the next round). Makes 3 fake endorsement rows and 1 fake log row.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run makes no second row.
after: T26 Make the fake publication r2
steps.doing: Making the fake rows for the Restore test.

steps.name: T26 Back up in a second window r2
steps.title: Back up the 12 lists in a second RADE window
steps.note: This window waits. A second RADE window saves the 12 lists of your test site to this computer. Nothing on the site changes.
guide: 1. On your Desktop, double-click the shortcut "RADE". A second RADE window opens.
2. In the second RADE window, click "90-161.Z 0.1.0". You see "90-161.Z 0.1.0" at the top.
3. In the second RADE window, click "Maintenance". You see "Back up" and "Restore".
4. Click "Back up". RADE shows that Back up is running.
5. If a CAC sign-in window opens, write down its size: "Small" or "Large".
6. If the CAC sign-in window is open, sign in with your CAC.
7. Wait until the second RADE window shows "All 12 lists were saved."
8. Close the second RADE window with its X. You see this window again.
If lists were not saved: click "It failed" and type the first line of the message.
after: T26 Make the Restore test rows r2

answers.prompt: What size did you write down for the CAC sign-in window of the second RADE window?

steps.name: T22 Check the Back up r16
steps.title: Check that the Back up saved all 12 lists
steps.note: Reads the newest backup folder on this computer: for each list, its 2 files and its row count. It reads no row values and changes nothing.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. If a list is missing, the Restore test stops here.
after: T26 Back up in a second window r2
steps.doing: Reading the newest backup.

steps.name: T26 Delete and add the test rows r2
steps.title: Delete 4 fake rows and add 1 on the test site
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Moves the 3 fake endorsement rows to the site Recycle Bin, deletes the fake log row for good, and adds 1 new fake endorsement row. Restore puts the 4 deleted rows back next.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run does only what is left.
after: T22 Check the Back up r16
steps.doing: Deleting 4 fake rows and adding 1.

steps.name: T26 Start Restore in a second window r2
steps.title: Start Restore in a second RADE window
steps.note: This window waits. Restore first does a dry run in the second window: it shows what it would put back and writes nothing. Keep the second window open after the dry run.
guide: 1. On your Desktop, double-click the shortcut "RADE". A second RADE window opens.
2. In the second RADE window, click "90-161.Z 0.1.0". You see "90-161.Z 0.1.0" at the top.
3. In the second RADE window, click "Maintenance". You see "Back up" and "Restore".
4. Click "Restore". You see "Which backup does Restore use?"
5. If RADE asks "Is the saved site a test site?", close the second RADE window with its X.
6. Click the backup marked "Newest". You see "The Restore dry run is running."
7. If a CAC sign-in window opens, sign in with your CAC.
8. Wait until the second RADE window shows a line that starts with "Dry run:".
9. Keep the second RADE window open.
If you closed the window at line 5: click "It failed" and type: RADE asked for the test site
after: T26 Delete and add the test rows r2

steps.name: T26 Answer: the Restore dry run r2
steps.title: Answer 1 question about the dry run
steps.note: 1 question about the line "Dry run:" in the second window. Keep the second window open.
after: T26 Start Restore in a second window r2

answers.prompt: In the second RADE window, what does the line "Dry run:" say?
choices: The Recycle Bin could not be read
failOn: The Recycle Bin could not be read

steps.name: T26 Restore with the app name r2
steps.title: Confirm Restore with the app name
steps.note: Restore saves a fresh backup and puts the 4 rows back. Keep the second window open for the questions.
guide: 1. In the second RADE window, click in the box "Type 90-161.Z to confirm".
3. Do not close the second RADE window while Restore runs.
4. Click "Restore". You see Restore run. Wait until the result shows.
5. In the result, find the line that starts with "PFM Endorsements".
6. Keep the second RADE window open for the 3 questions.
after: T26 Answer: the Restore dry run r2

answers.prompt: In the second RADE window, what does the first line of the result say?
Does the result say that the pause switch is back as it was?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: Restore ran in the second window.

steps.name: T26 Answer: the Recycle Bin rows r2
steps.title: Answer 1 question about the Recycle Bin rows
after: T26 Restore with the app name r2
steps.note: 1 question about the line "PFM Endorsements" in the result in the second window. Keep the second window open.

answers.prompt: The line "PFM Endorsements" says "X back from the Recycle Bin, Y made new". What are X and Y?

steps.name: T26 Close the second window r2
steps.title: Close the second RADE window
steps.note: The Restore test in the second window is complete.
guide: 1. Close the second RADE window with its X. You see this window again.
after: T26 Answer: the Recycle Bin rows r2

steps.name: T26 Check the restored rows r2
steps.title: Check the rows that Restore put back
steps.note: Signs in (CAC) and reads only: the 3 rows back with their old numbers, the log row with a new number, the new row still there, the pause-switch row at No, and the fresh backup.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
after: T26 Restore with the app name r2
steps.doing: Checking the rows that Restore put back.

steps.name: T26 Remove the fake rows r2
steps.title: Remove the fake publication and its answers
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Moves the fake publication, its endorsement rows (yours and the answers) and its log rows to the site Recycle Bin. Runs after any failure.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
steps.doing: Removing the fake rows.

steps.name: T21 Remove the test list and library r12
steps.title: Remove the test person, list and library
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Takes the second person out of Visitors and moves the test list and library to the Recycle Bin. Runs after any failure.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. Each removal runs even when an earlier one fails.
steps.doing: Removing the test list and library.

steps.name: T20 Make the 12 lists r4
steps.title: Make the 12 lists of 90-161.Z on the site
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes the 12 lists of 90-161.Z on the site with their columns, views and start rows, and the group PFM Office with its permission level. Skips what is there. Removes nothing.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run changes nothing.
steps.doing: Making the 12 lists.

steps.name: T27 Remove the 12 lists r1
steps.title: Remove the 12 lists that the install made
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Uninstall step. Moves the 12 lists of 90-161.Z to the site Recycle Bin, found by their fixed titles. A list with another title stays.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run finds nothing left.
steps.doing: Removing the 12 lists.

steps.name: T27 Remove the group and level r1
steps.title: Remove the group and level that the install made
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Uninstall step. Removes the group PFM Office and its permission level only when RADE recorded that the install made them. Otherwise they stay. No other group or level is removed.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run finds nothing left.
steps.doing: Removing the group and the level.

steps.name: T27 Remove the install note r1
steps.title: Remove the install note on this computer
steps.note: Uninstall step. Removes the install note file of this computer. RADE keeps its own install record.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run finds nothing left.
steps.doing: Removing the install note.

steps.name: T27 Remove the flows by hand r1
steps.title: Remove the flows of 90-161.Z in Power Automate
steps.note: Uninstall step. Removes the solution of the 90-161.Z flows, if it was imported by hand. The install does not make it. Words marked "not from the bundle" are Power Automate text.
guide: 1. Open the Power Automate site for your environment.
2. On the left, click "Solutions" (not from the bundle). You see the solutions.
3. Find the solution "90-161.Z flows". If it is not there, click "Skip".
4. Click the 3 dots next to "90-161.Z flows" (not from the bundle).
5. Click "Delete", then click "Delete" again in the question (not from the bundle).
6. Wait until "90-161.Z flows" is not in the list of solutions.
If the delete fails: click "It failed" and type the first line of the message.

steps.name: T27 Check the lists before Uninstall r1
steps.title: Check the 12 lists before Uninstall
steps.note: Signs in (CAC) and reads only. Shows that the 12 lists are on the site before Uninstall.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
steps.doing: Reading the lists of the site.

steps.name: T27 Check Uninstall removed the lists r1
steps.title: Check that Uninstall removed the 12 lists
steps.note: Signs in (CAC) and reads only. Passes when none of the 12 lists of 90-161.Z is on the site.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
steps.doing: Reading the lists of the site.

steps.name: T27 Check the new install r1
steps.title: Check the 12 lists after the new install
steps.note: Signs in (CAC) and reads only. Passes when the 12 lists are on the site again with their process steps.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
steps.doing: Reading the lists of the site.
after: T27 Check Uninstall removed the lists r1

steps.name: T26 Make the fake publication after install r2
steps.title: Make the fake publication on the new install
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes one fake publication (with OPR, level, type and 673 link) and one fake endorsement on the test site, or finds them. Puts text on the clipboard that this part does not use.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run makes no second row.
steps.doing: Making the fake publication.
after: T27 Check the new install r1

steps.name: T27 Move the fake publication one step r1
steps.title: Move the fake publication from step 1 to step 2
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Checks the exit conditions of step 1 (DAFMAN 90-161 3.1) on the fake publication, moves it to step 2 (3.2) only if they hold, reads it back and checks them again.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run changes nothing.
steps.doing: Moving the fake publication to step 2.
after: T26 Make the fake publication after install r2

steps.name: T26 Remove the fake rows after install r2
steps.title: Remove the fake publication and its rows
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Moves the fake publication and its rows to the site Recycle Bin. Runs after any failure.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.
steps.doing: Removing the fake rows.
